pr_mfy TEXT, pr_mfy_id TEXT, pr_region TEXT, pr_address TEXT, pr_country TEXT, pr_cadastre TEXT, pr_district TEXT, pr_region_id TEXT, pr_country_id TEXT, pr_district_id TEXT, pr_region_id_cbu TEXT, pr_country_id_cbu TEXT, pr_district_id_cbu TEXT, pr_registration_date TEXT,
tr_mfy TEXT, tr_mfy_id TEXT, tr_region TEXT, tr_address TEXT, tr_cadastre TEXT, tr_district TEXT, tr_date_from TEXT, tr_date_till TEXT, tr_region_id TEXT, tr_district_id TEXT, tr_region_id_cbu TEXT, tr_district_id_cbu TEXT,
created_date TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, last_modified_date TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP );
